t: Sections 1654 (termination of retail tax on luggage, etc.) and 1655 (definition of “date of the termination of hostilities in the present war”) of such Code are hereby repealed.

fable.w: This section only repeals two Internal Revenue Code provisions, one ending a retail tax on luggage and one defining a wartime date. There is no tempting reading here: it involves no consultation, hearing, rulemaking, advisory body, or right to sue, and no party outside the federal government takes part in any federal decision.

qwen_block.w: This section simply repeals existing statutory provisions regarding taxes and definitions. It does not establish any process for consultation, public comment, advisory committees, or coordination with outside parties. There is no interaction with non-federal entities described in the text.
qwen_block.s: Sections 1654 (termination of retail tax on luggage, etc.) and 1655 (definition of “date of the termination of hostilities in the present war”) of such Code are hereby repealed.
